summary: Building AI agents that do marketing work on their own (writing, publishing, chatting with website visitors) for an AI go-to-market platform.
highlights: Built an AI chatbot any company can drop onto its website: it answers visitors live, and the team can jump into any conversation from their inbox.
Shipped an AI blog agent that writes posts and publishes them straight to a customer's Webflow site, and can update or take them down later.
Made agents run themselves on a schedule set in plain English ("twice a week at 2pm"), working through a topic list without repeating topics.

summary: Building features end-to-end across a Next.js front end and a MERN-stack backend, plus a React Native mobile app, with a Redis caching layer that took slow APIs from seconds to sub-second.
highlights: Added Redis caching with invalidation on writes to slow, high-traffic APIs, taking responses from seconds to sub-second and easing database load.
Shipped user-facing features across a production Next.js web platform and its React Native app, keeping both clients in sync on a shared API.
Integrated third-party APIs and background jobs to automate recurring workflows, cutting manual operations effort for the team.

summary: Built a sandboxed, LeetCode-style code judge (React + FastAPI) that runs submissions against test cases in multiple languages, plus a MongoDB query playground.
highlights: Built a sandboxed, LeetCode-style code judge (React + FastAPI) that runs submissions against test cases in multiple languages.
Built an isolated MongoDB query playground where students run their own database scripts safely.
Added real-time submission feedback that streams execution output to users as test cases run, replacing the previous wait-for-completion flow.
